nodes.norm_label: data model (rls-scoped transactions, shared/user-owned categories & accounts)

nodes.label: Vitest Test Suite for lib/finance.ts
nodes.rationale: Financial math functions had zero test coverage, making every refactor or deploy blind; a Vitest suite was added to verify them.

nodes.label: Atomic Transfer RPC (create_transfer)
nodes.rationale: Two separate INSERTs could leave a transfer record with no matching transaction; a single security-definer plpgsql transaction makes both insert atomically.

nodes.label: Write Idempotency via idempotency_key
nodes.rationale: Network retries and double-clicks could create duplicate rows; a UNIQUE idempotency_key with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING makes writes idempotent.

nodes.label: account_id FK for Balance Computation
nodes.rationale: payment_method string matching broke balances when account names changed; storing the account UUID makes balance calculations immune to renames.

nodes.label: Server-Side Money Validation (CHECK Constraints + RPCs)
nodes.rationale: Browser-to-Supabase writes via the anon key had no validation; DB CHECK constraints plus validated security-definer RPCs enforce amount/type rules server-side.

nodes.label: Integer Cents Money Storage
nodes.rationale: IEEE-754 doubles accumulate rounding errors (0.1+0.2 != 0.3); storing bigint cents and converting at read/write boundaries keeps money exact.

nodes.label: Session Expiry Handling (redirectIfAuthError)
nodes.rationale: Invalidated sessions silently failed mutations; an onAuthStateChanged listener plus a redirectIfAuthError helper redirect to /login.

nodes.label: Sanitized Supabase Error Messages
nodes.rationale: Raw Supabase errors leaked table/constraint/auth internals; a central sanitizeError maps them to user-safe generic messages.

nodes.label: Soft Delete with Undo (deleted_at)
nodes.rationale: Hard deletes were unrecoverable; a deleted_at timestamp, a restore_transaction RPC, and Undo banners enable in-session recovery.

nodes.label: /api/chat In-Memory Rate Limiter
nodes.rationale: Unlimited /api/chat was abusable; a 20 req/min/IP in-memory window (stateless, adequate for single-instance deployment) addresses it.

nodes.label: Blocker → Critical → Major → Minor Priority Order
nodes.norm_label: blocker → critical → major → minor priority order

nodes.label: Soft Delete Reverted (Hard Delete Restored)
nodes.rationale: The soft delete from CHANGES_DOCUMENTATION was reverted; hard-delete RPC restored and .is('deleted_at', null) filters removed.

nodes.label: Core Product Philosophy (Fast Capture, Awareness, Insights, Conversational)
nodes.rationale: The dashboard exists to support decisions, not just display data; focuses on capture speed, awareness, actionable insights, and conversational finance over charts.
nodes.norm_label: core product philosophy (fast capture, awareness, insights, conversational)

nodes.label: 5-Second Transaction Logging Metric
nodes.rationale: Primary success metric: logging a transaction in under 5 seconds — drives the fast-capture-first design.

nodes.label: Mobile-First Rule (375/390/430px)
nodes.rationale: Design for 375/390/430px before tablets/desktop; every screen must remain fully usable on mobile.

nodes.label: Build Sequentially Rule
nodes.rationale: Complete the current phase before starting the next; do not skip phases.

nodes.label: Technology Stack (Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Vercel)
nodes.norm_label: technology stack (next.js, typescript, tailwind, supabase, postgresql, vercel)

nodes.label: Security Requirements (RLS, User-Scoped Policies)
nodes.rationale: All user-owned tables use RLS; users may only view/insert/update/delete their own records, never another user's financial data.

nodes.label: Custom Next.js Version (Breaking Changes)
nodes.rationale: This repository ships a Next.js build whose APIs, conventions, and file structure differ from standard training-data Next.js; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ guides before writing code and heed deprecation notices.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Agents should answer relation questions via the graph (nodes, communities, edges) rather than grepping raw files, and rebuild the graph after major refactors.
